d:
Kudiyan Shehar Diyan is one of those songs that defined an era — vibrant, playful, and full of life.
Composed and sung by Daler Mehndi, this iconic track featured in the Bollywood film Arjun Pandit, starring the ever-charming Juhi Chawla.
This song holds a special place in my heart — it was composed in Nashik during the Coca-Cola Tour, capturing the spirit of travel, music, and spontaneous creativity.
Even after years, Kudiyan Shehar Diyan continues to bring smiles, energy, and nostalgia to audiences across generations.
Turn up the volume and relive the magic.
• Daler Mehndi
